title: Skin Care During Flight: Before, During and After Flying
ex: Why cabin air dries your skin, a hand-baggage skin kit, what to do on board and a first-night routine for the weather you land in.
rt: Skin Care During Flight: Simple Travel Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care during a flight: moisturise before boarding, sip water, reapply cream and lip balm on long flights, and match your routine to the city you land in.
quick: Plane cabin air is very dry, so moisturise clean skin before boarding, wear sunscreen on day flights, keep makeup light, drink water and reapply lip balm. On flights longer than about 4 hours, press a thin layer of cream on again with clean hands.
facts: Cabin air is much drier than air on the ground
Lips and hands dry out first
Avoid starting new actives before a trip
Check airline rules for creams in hand baggage
